conversation.Statement: Good afternoon, is this Jamie Turner? This is Agent Roberts calling from the IRS Investigations Department.
Uh, yes, this is Jamie. Did you say IRS? What's this about?
Jamie, our records show discrepancies in your recent federal tax filings. There is an outstanding balance and possible misreporting for the last tax year.
Wait, I just graduated and started working last year. I used TurboTax. I thought everything was fine.
Unfortunately, our audit indicates you underreported your income, leading to unpaid taxes. This is a serious federal violation.
Oh my god, I didn't know. No one told me anything. Am I in trouble?
Jamie, we have already issued a formal notice. As of today, there is a legal warrant for your arrest. If this is not resolved immediately, law enforcement will proceed.
Arrest? No, that can't be right! Is there anything I can do? I can't get arrested, I just got this job!
If you fail to cooperate, your driver's license and bank accounts will be frozen within 24 hours. You must act now to avoid further penalties.
Please, I really didn't mean to do anything wrong. I'll fix it. What do I have to do?
You need to settle the owed amount outside of court today. If you comply, the warrant will be voided and your record will remain clean.
Okay, I just... how much is it? I don't have a lot of money right now.
The outstanding tax balance plus penalties totals $2,950. We require payment using government-approved methods only, do not attempt to pay through your regular bank account.
I don't understand. How am I supposed to pay, then?
You must purchase Apple or Target gift cards for the full amount. This is for secure verification and to prevent further fraudulent activity.
Gift cards? That seems weird. Are you sure that's how the IRS does this?
This is a special protocol for urgent cases under investigation. If you do not follow instructions, the enforcement process cannot be halted. Do you understand?
Okay, okay. I'll go to the store. What do I do once I have the cards?
Once you buy the cards, return to this call and provide me with the card numbers and validation codes so I can process the payment and cancel your warrant.
Alright, I'm leaving now. Please don't let them arrest me. I'll call you back as soon as I have the cards.
Stay on the line with me if possible. If you hang up, it may trigger the automated enforcement action. Are you ready to proceed now?
